 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86556180028dfb57d5206378800bb5dc697657fffe6b69905f7a2d72738cfd42.png] 

The imports in 1974 were approximately how many times that of the year 1971?
solution:
**Given:- ** 

Imports in 1974 = 6000 

Imports in 1971 = 1600

**Calculation:-**

Imports ratio = Imports in 1974 / Imports in 1971

Imports ratio = 6000 / 1600

Imports ratio = 3.75

**∴The imports in 1974 were 3.75 times that of the imports in 1971**.
